verdict: Reuse unchanged funding-allocation-v0.1 and TradeResult INCLUDED semantics with source_kind=PAPER_MODEL; new registered E4 model/ordinary integration required, not a shared schema or financial-authority extension.

facts.text: PAPER_MODEL is explicit versioned E4 simulation truth; BROKER_LEDGER means authoritative broker/account ledger. Section9.2 expressly permits deterministic simulated funding events as INCLUDED. Public rates applied to synthetic positions remain PAPER_MODEL, never actual account funding.

Current registries are concrete closed implementations: exact registered PaperZero model, or issuer-bound FIXTURE ledger source. Neither accepts a new public-rate model by changing strings or supplying caller dictionaries.

E5 accepts PAPER_MODEL or BROKER_LEDGER, INCLUDED with >=1 record and finite signed USDT cost, including net-zero records. Positive cost subtracts; negative cost credits. Exact plan/position/symbol/first-fill-to-flat interval and complete watermark required. E5 does not acquire rates or certify their source.

E6 validates shape/status/completeness/identity, persists immutable evidence, rejects same-lineage conflicting allocation, binds TradeResult cost/status and recovers original graph. Storage acceptance is not source authority; it cannot manufacture completeness or choose conflicting truth.

Ordinary policy and closed report validator currently hardcode zero funding. These real integration blockers require additive versioned model selection/report support; existing zero histories must retain their original interpretation.

recommended_design: Register one E4-owned immutable public-recorded-rate Paper model/version, retaining PAPER_MODEL provenance. Normalize actual archived public observations into deterministic model allocation records; hash ordered source/model material, coverage and exact lineage.

Define settlement timestamps, synthetic signed quantity/notional valuation across fills, Decimal rounding and complete historical coverage explicitly. Public rates alone do not establish charged account amounts; unavailable/partial/ambiguous coverage emits no final evidence.

Reuse half-open [opened_at,first authoritative flat observation) allocation, stable17-field identity, duplicate rejection, signed aggregation and existing immutable outbox/recovery. INCLUDED with zero net stays INCLUDED; no applicable events permits ZERO_CONFIRMED only with affirmative complete model evidence.
authority_constraints: Contract sections13.1-13.4 reserve source to E4, financial validation to E5, storage to E6 and compatibility to E7. Existing contract allows this modeled path; no demonstrated need for new private/LIVE/capital authority. Public transport authorization remains separate. No model price/settlement formula or completeness rule is invented here.
concrete_remaining: Implement and test registered model plus ordinary close/report wiring and durable actual-public-source retention. The normative modeled-event contract exists; actual public funding allocation semantics/source coverage must be specified before claiming full modeled costs.
